description.content:
Creates a portal, which can contain projects and dashboards. IoT SiteWise Monitor uses IAM Identity Center or IAM to authenticate portal users and manage user permissions.

Before you can sign in to a new portal, you must add at least one identity to that portal. For more information, see Adding or removing portal administrators in the IoT SiteWise User Guide.

info.name: AWS IoT SiteWise Access Policies Portals API

description.content: Welcome to the IoT SiteWise API Reference. IoT SiteWise is an Amazon Web Services service that connects Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) devices to the power of the Amazon Web Services Cloud. For more information, see the IoT SiteWise User Guide. For information about IoT SiteWise quotas, see Quotas in the IoT SiteWise User Guide. Contact Support: Name: Mike Ralphson Email: mike.ralphson@gmail.com
